content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Gentlease is a ready-to-feed infant formula designed to ease colic, gas, and tummy discomfort in babies. It contains partially hydrolyzed proteins, easily digestible carbohydrates, and an optimal fat blend, making it gentle on the digestive system.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Gentlease uses partially hydrolyzed proteins that are easier to digest than whole proteins.
The formula is fortified with DHA and ARA, fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
No reconstitution required – the product is ready to feed straight from the container.
Enfamil Gentlease has undergone clinical studies demonstrating its effectiveness in reducing infant colic.
Suitable for infants from birth up to 12 months, including newborns.

items.title: Supports Digestion
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed proteins and prebiotics help reduce gas and tummy discomfort.

items.title: Brain Development
items.content: DHA and ARA contribute to normal development of the central nervous system and visual function.

items.title: Balanced Nutrition
items.content: The formula provides essential vitamins and minerals such as iron, calcium, and vitamin D for bone growth and overall development.

items.title: Convenient Preparation
items.content: Ready-to-feed format eliminates the need to mix powder with water, reducing preparation errors.

items.title: Immune Support
items.content: Vitamin C, zinc, and other micronutrients help strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Milk Protein Allergy
items.content: Children with known cow’s milk protein or lactose allergy may react to the formula.

items.title: Sugar Content
items.content: The formula contains lactose; infants with lactase deficiency may experience discomfort.

items.title: Post‑Opening Storage
items.content: After opening, keep the container refrigerated and use within 48 hours to prevent spoilage.

items.title: Not a Breast Milk Substitute
items.content: While designed to ease colic, it does not replace the benefits of breast milk.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Shake the bottle before use, check the expiration date, open the cap, and feed the baby directly. If desired, chill in the refrigerator, but do not freeze.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and use within 48 hours.
